# The automation contract: on non-TTY stdin sync never prompts and never
# clobbers — drifted docs are skipped, reported on stderr, exit 1. --force
# overwrites without asking.

fulcrum sync
cp edited.json skills/estimation-rubric.json

fulcrum -code 1 sync
grep 'skipped estimation-rubric.json' last-stderr.txt
grep 'skipped to protect local edits' last-stderr.txt
cmp skills/estimation-rubric.json edited.json

fulcrum sync --force
cmp skills/estimation-rubric.json $CORPUS/documents/estimation-rubric.json
fulcrum status
grep 'synced' last-stdout.txt

-- edited.json --
{
  "rubric_id": "org-default",
  "status": "edited-locally"
}
